mcq_drop.why: ambiguous A-R: Indo-Greek basis arguably explains Gandhara's style; keyed 'not explanation' is contestable

pyq_bad.why: garbled options (truncated codes, stray 'PMF IAS' text)

patterns: Most-asked fact: Gandhara = Indian + Greek synthesis, flourished under the Kushanas (many near-identical PYQs incl. APPSC 2018).
Material and mudra identification: schist = Gandhara; Sarnath Bhumisparsha/Dharmachakra Buddha = Gupta period.
'Oldest/first' Buddha image questions (Mathura per IAS 2012; Buddha = first worshipped human statue).
APPSC angle is Amaravati: sites (Nagarjunakonda, Bhattiprolu), Satavahana-Ikshvaku patronage, white limestone, Fergusson/Percy Brown.
App relies on long comparison tables turned into 3-statement and match items; exam uses simple one-line identification.
